gloss: municipalities; cities, wards, towns, and villages

definitions.gloss: municipalities; cities, wards, towns, and villages
definitions.explanation: A collective term for the four types of local government units in Japan: cities (市), special wards (区), towns (町), and villages (村). Used to refer to local municipalities as a group.

examples.japanese: {市区町村|しくちょうそん}コードを{入力|にゅうりょく}する。
{住所|じゅうしょ}は{都道府県|とどうふけん}と{市区町村|しくちょうそん}を{分|わ}けて{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write the address with the prefecture and municipality separated.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}の{市区町村|しくちょうそん}のうち、{人口|じんこう}{減少|げんしょう}に{直面|ちょくめん}しているところが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Among all municipalities nationwide, many are facing population decline.

notes:
A four-character compound listing the four types of basic local government in Japan: {市|し} (city), {区|く} (ward), {町|ちょう} (town), {村|そん} (village). Frequently encountered on government forms and official documents.

STRUCTURE:
- {市|し}: city — population generally over 50,000
- {区|く}: ward — the 23 special wards of Tokyo
- {町|ちょう}: town — smaller than a city
- {村|そん}: village — the smallest unit

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市区町村|しくちょうそん}コード: municipality code
- {市区町村|しくちょうそん}{名|めい}: municipality name
- {市区町村|しくちょうそん}{合併|がっぺい}: municipal merger

RELATED TERMS:
- {都道府県|とどうふけん}: prefectures — the level above municipalities in Japan's administrative hierarchy
- {自治体|じちたい}: local government body — a broader term for any autonomous local entity
- {基礎自治体|きそじちたい}: basic municipality — the formal administrative term
